info.name: Hash
info.comment: Computes a message digest or HMAC incrementally.

description.p: Hash objects process data in independently bounded chunks, allowing messages larger than the one-shot Crypto function limit of 1 MiB. Select Algorithm before initialisation. To compute an HMAC, also set Key before initialisation; leaving the key unset selects an ordinary digest. An explicitly supplied empty key selects HMAC with an empty key.
MD5 and SHA-1 are available only for compatibility with existing formats and protocols. They are not suitable for security purposes. Use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for new designs.
Calling Digest does not change the running state, so more data may be appended afterwards. Call Reset to begin a new message while retaining the selected algorithm and key.
-ERRORS- Okay FieldNotSet: Algorithm has not been set. NoSupport: Algorithm is not supported. AllocMemory: The platform hashing context could not be allocated.

result.error: The platform hashing context could not be allocated.

action.name: Reset
action.comment: Starts a new digest or HMAC with the same algorithm and key.

description.p: -ERRORS- Okay NotInitialised: The object has not been initialised. Failed: The cryptography provider failed.

result.error: The object has not been initialised.

method.name: Digest
method.comment: Copies the current digest or HMAC to an output array.

description.p: Output must be exactly 16 bytes for MD5, 20 for SHA-1, 32 for SHA-256 or 64 for SHA-512. This method does not change the running state.

result.error: The object has not been initialised.

method.name: Update
method.comment: Adds a chunk of data to the running digest or HMAC.
method.prototype: ERR hsh::Update(OBJECTPTR Object, std::span<const int8_t> Data)

input.param: The next data chunk, up to 1 MiB.

description.p: Each Data chunk may contain up to 1 MiB. Call this method repeatedly to process a larger message.

result.error: The object has not been initialised.

field.name: Algorithm
field.comment: Message digest algorithm selected before initialisation.

field.name: Key
field.comment: Selects HMAC mode and provides its authentication key.

description.p: Set this write-only field before initialisation to select HMAC. The key may be empty and may contain null bytes. Leaving the field unset selects an ordinary message digest. The key is copied into private object storage and cleared when the object is destroyed.

constants.const: MD5 (compatibility only; not suitable for security purposes).
SHA-1 (compatibility only; not suitable for security purposes).
